name: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Ltd

promises.delivery: In progress: ~2,400 operational beds at Q1 FY27, 59% occupancy
Q1 FY27 PAT Rs 65.7cr (+28% YoY); FY27 target Rs 309cr
Not yet material; clinical trials done, launches due
promises.promise: Rs 300-500cr turnover from OTC/products in 1-2 years

promises.delivery: Sep-29-2026: Bhavna Grover bought 25,000 shares open market, nil encumbrance
promises.promise: Promoter buying into weakness (observed, not promised)

risks: Valuation: 68% above DCF fair value (Rs 412 vs Rs 245); PE 23x on decelerating margin expansion
Momentum: -41% in 1 year, at 52-week low on 2.5x volume; FII holding fell 6.6% -> 4.8%
Execution: 10,000-bed target needs sustained capex + occupancy; 59% occupancy leaves little slack
Q1 FY27 other income Rs 14cr (~Rs 7cr one-off); core margin trajectory matters more than headline PAT
Ayurveda regulatory risk (AYUSH compliance) and competition from organized hospital chains
thesis: Financially clean Ayurveda healthcare compounder (60% ROE, zero debt, 32-day receivables, all E-rules clear) in a structural growth segment. The engine finds no distress — the problem is purely price: Rs 412 vs Rs 245 DCF fair value. The 41% derating hasn't closed the valuation gap. Quality company, wrong price.
